No content or file changes detected in this version.

- No updates were made; content and structure remain unchanged from the previous release.

Initial release of the tax-planning skill.

- Guides solopreneurs through understanding and planning for tax obligations, including federal, state, and self-employment taxes.
- Explains how to calculate and make quarterly estimated tax payments to avoid penalties.
- Details the most valuable business tax deductions, including home office, equipment, mileage, and retirement contributions.
- Covers the benefits, process, and criteria for electing S-Corp status to reduce self-employment taxes.
- Provides a practical year-end tax planning checklist to minimize tax liability.
- Includes triggers and clear educational notes; users are advised to consult a CPA for personalized advice.
